thread:
marie: Quick follow-up from RDI-4021 postmortem: can we agree owners for the regression suites and a small chaos drill? Need dates so we can put them in the follow-ups section.
rob: I'll take the stop-seq regression. Plan is a tiny JSON test that asserts complete sequences and a token-distribution sanity check. CI-friendly (<=30s).
anya: I'll own the fallback-role-tokenization suite and add it to the eval harness. Will include a KV warmup and a short prefix to reproduce the drift.
sanjay: I'll do the chaos drill (fallback + node loss). Proposed run: baseline 200 rps, 60s spike to 800 rps, drain 2 GPUs at t+90s. Will add runbook and abort criteria.
marie: Suggested deadlines: rob -> stop-seq suite by 2026-04-02 EOD; anya -> fallback prompts + harness gate by 2026-04-03; sanjay -> chaos drill runbook + dry-run by 2026-04-09. OK?
rob: Works for me. I'll add a small unit test example:
```json
{"prompt":"user: hi\nassistant:","assert":"no_truncation"}
```
anya: I'll also add an alert when top-k token distribution shifts > 5% and a CI badge to fail when regression suite has any failures.
marie: Rotation for triage when CI fails: proposal: eng-ml weekdays 09-18, eng-platform nights/weekends. We should write a short oncall doc.
sanjay: Will integrate the k6 script into our load pipeline and tag the postmortem ticket. k6 spike snippet:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt: 'role:system\nuser: test'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
bot-ci: Created task RDI-4199 assigned to sanjay (chaos drill) due 2026-04-09.
marie: Recap owners/due dates: rob (stop-seq suite) 2026-04-02, anya (fallback prompts + eval gate) 2026-04-03, sanjay (chaos drill + runbook) 2026-04-09, marie (publish rotation doc + update postmortem) 2026-04-01. I'll update the postmortem follow-ups with these links.
anya: Quick question: should the fallback prompt-set live under `suites/regression/fallback_role_tokenization.json`?
rob: Yes, and keep CI job name `ci-eval/regression-lite` for fast checks.
marie: Cool. If anyone slips on dates, put a comment in the ticket and @marie so we can triage. :thumbsup:
